ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by one-month forward discount, then go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
ideas.quote: The fifth panel reports returns on zero-cost strategies that go long in the high interest rate portfolio and short in the low interest rate portfolio.

rules.market: Currencies against USD, including major and other currencies; the reported sample is not limited to FX majors.
rules.entry: At each month-end, sort currencies by one-month forward discount; go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest.
rules.exit: Reform portfolios at the end of each month.
rules.filters: The paper excludes specified currency observations during periods of large covered interest parity failures.

ideas.claimed_result: For the all-country sample from January 1983 to December 2009, the annualized high-minus-low return was 4.54% after bid-ask spreads, with a Sharpe ratio of 0.50.
required_data: USD spot exchange rates and bid-ask quotes
One-month forward exchange rates and bid-ask quotes
